content: Ayesu bhaalamia amundu bhabhile na mambujupuju
Ayesu pabhakatuluka kubhoka palitombi, lilubhalo likolongwa lya bhandu bhajingi likaakagula.
Bahi, bhakahika amundu bhamo bhabhi atamwa mambujupuju, bhakaatindibhalila majugwa na kwaalobholela, “Hangwana, handa mpalite, nkombola kulamia nenga!”
Ayesu bhakanyulula lubhoko lwabhe na kunkwaa na kulobhola, “Ndenda kupala! Nname.” Mala bhena amundu bhakalama mambujupuju gabhe.
Ngapena Ayesu bhakaalobholela, “Nnole nkoto kunnobholela mundu bhoabhala, nambo nnyaule kwa akaakung'i na kubhoa ngwahupa jijikahukumulikwa na Amusa ili kwaalangia yakubhee ntekulama.”
Ayesu bhaalamia akolo bhamo bha manyemba ga ku Lumi
Ayesu pabhakahika pannyini ku Kafalanaumu, akolo bhamo bha manyemba ga ku Lumi bhakaajendelela na kwaapembelela bhaanyangatile.
Kongo bhabhi kulobhola, “Hangwana, antumichi bhangu bhatekugoloka kaaja atamwa muno na bhatekupola.”
Ayesu bhakaalobholela, “Mbakuhika kwaalamia.”
Bhenabho akolo bha manyemba ga ku Lumi bhakaalobholela Ayesu, “Hangwana, ngapalikwa mwenga nnyingile mu nyuumba jangu. Nambo nlagie tu lilobhole limo na antumichi bhangu bhapakulama.

Kwa kubhee nenga na mwene nga amundu nibhekitwe pahi ja mamulaka, ngweti manyemba pahi jangu. Handa mbakwaalobholela habhabha, ‘Nnyaule,’ na bhenabho bhakajaula. Na bhangi handa naalobholile, ‘Nhike,’ bhenabho bhatenda kuhika. Na handa mbakwaalobholela antumichi bhangu, ‘Npangane henela,’ na bhenabho bhapakungana.”

Ayesu pabhakajoha genago, bhakakangacha muno, akabhalobholelanga bhandu bhabhakibha bhaakagula, “Ndendakunnobholelanga kweli, nangapata kwaabhona amundu bhoa bhala mu chilambo cha ku Isilaeli bhakuhobhalela muno handa bhenabho.

Bahi ndendakunnobholelanga yakubhee bhandu bhajingi bhapakuhika kubhoka kuulabho na kuuwelo, na bhena angota bhapakutamanga ili bhalyee pamo na Aaibulahimu, na Aisaka, na Ayakobo mu Umwenye gwa kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo.
Nambo bhenibhala yakubhee Umwenye gonogwe gwa Annoongo nga gwabhenji bhapakwaajeha panja, palubhendu, konokwe bhapakugutanga na kuyaga mino.”
Kubhoka penapo Ayesu bhakaalobholela bhenabho akolo bha manyemba ga Ku Lumi, “Nnyaule kwaachinu na ibhee handa chinhobhalile.” Na antumichi bhabhe bhakalama muda gogogo.
Ayesu bhaalamia bhandu bhajingi
Ayesu bhakahika kwaachabhe Apetulo, bhakaakolela hakibhabhe haikege bhagolwike pachindanda, bhatenda kulwala muno.
Bahi, Ayesu bhakaakamula lubhoko bhenibhala haikege, na bhakalama bhakajema na kujemeka kwabhekela tayali chakulya.
Pajikahika kimuo, bhakaaletela bhandu bhajingi bhabhakibha na mahoka, na bhenabho Ayesu bhakaakulumikiha mahoka gabhoke kwa bhandu. Kabhele bhakaalamia bhandu bhoa bhabhakibha akaatamwa.
Akatenda henela kupala genigala malobhe gaakalongela alondoi bhakeemitwa Aisaya galenganile, “Bhenabho bheene bhatekutupetula na kupongokewa kwitu, na bhatekuhipetula itamwa yitu.”
Namuna chibhapalikwa kubhee bhabhaakagula Ayesu
Ayesu pabhakabhona lilubhalo likolongwa lya bhandu litekwaatindila, nga bhakaakulumikia bhabhachijigina bhabhe bhajombokange kujenda kuntundu ja litanda.
Bhabhajigana bhamo bha Malagilo ga Amusa bhakaajendelela Ayesu na kwaalobholela, “Bhannyigana, nenga mbakunkagula koha kola kumpakujenda.”
Ayesu bhakaajangula, “Mabwea gakweti macheembo, na hijuni hikweti hiyua, nambo amwana bha amundu bhakwetihopo chehemu ja kupomolelela.”
Ngapena amundu bhamo nkati ja bhabhachijigana bhabhe bhakaalobholela Ayesu, “Hangwana, naanjinu nneke oti ngaachike Atati bhangu.”
Nambo Ayesu bhakaalobholela, “Nkagule nenga! Nneke bhandu bhabhabhilinge handa bhajomwike bhachikane na bhandu handa bhabhawilinge.”
Ayesu bhajikotoa mboongo jikotoke
Ayesu bhakakwela mu mtumbwi nkolongwa, na bhabhachijigana bhabhe bhakaakagula.
Mala mboongo ngolongwa jikabhokela mulitanda, na mawimbi gakajemeka kugupukunyapukunya ntumbwi nkolongwa. Na muda gonogwe Ayesu bhabhi tangu bhagolwike lugono.
Bhabhachijigana bhakaajendelela na kwaajimua, bhabhi kulobhola, “Hangwana ntuchobhole.” “Tutendakujomoka!”
Ayesu akaajangulanga, “Mwe mwangota mmilinge na kuhobhalela kuchoko!” “Mboni ntenda kujogopanga?” Bahi, bhakajinuka na bhakajikalipila mboongo na mawimbi, na mboongo jikakotoka.
Bhandu bhoa bhakakangachanga, bhabhi kulobhola, “Nga mundu jwa namuna niki hojojo?” “Hata mawimbi na mboongo jitendakwaajohanikia!”
Ayesu bhaalamia bhandu bhabhele bhabhilinge na mahoka

Ayesu pabhakahika ku chilambo cha bha Gadala, kuntundu ja litanda, na konokwe bhandu bhabhele bhabhakapoganikwa na mahoka gabhou bhakakongana nabho bhabhi kubhokanga kumakabuli. Bhandu habha bhakibha bhakalipa muno, hata pangabhee na amundu bhabhakajiga kupeta mu ndela jenejo.
Bhenaangota bhakajemeka kupotanga nyenye, “Mmi na niki na tweenga, mwe Mwana bha Annoongo? Bholi, ntekuhika kutulagia tangu muda gwangahika?”
Kubhandikila na penapo pakibha na magolobhe gajingi bhatendita kugaliyanga.
Bahi, genago mahoka gabhou gakaapembelela Ayesu, “Handa mpakutubhoa, bahi ntuluke tukagajingile magolobhe gala.”

Ayesu akaalobholelanga, “Nnyaulange, penapo bhakaabhoanga bhenibhala bhandu, na kujingila mumagolobhe gala. Lilubhalo lyoa lya magolobhe likabhutukila mu chihelelo chikolongwa, likajingila mu bahali, magolobhe goa gakawee na machi.”
Bhenibhala bhandu bhabhalanga genigala magolobhe bhakabhutukanga na bhakajaula kunnyini, konokwe bhakakongolela ngani joha jijikapetela kwa bhenibhala bhandu bhabhi na mahoka.
Kubhoka penapo bhandu bhoa bha pannyini bhakabhoka na kwaajendelela Ayesu, na pabhakaabhona bhakaapembelela bhabhoke pachilambo chabhe.
